definitions.explanation: A pair of sticks used for eating in Japan and other Asian countries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{割|わ}り{箸|ばし}→割り箸：09725_waribashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{箸|はし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{箸|はし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わかります→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you know how to use chopsticks?

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{箸|はし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, sticking chopsticks upright in rice is considered a breach of etiquette.

notes:
{箸|はし} are the essential eating utensils in Japan. ⟦お{箸|はし}→お箸：10275_ohashi⟧ is the polite form.

TYPES:
- ⟦{割|わ}り{箸|ばし}→割り箸：09725_waribashi⟧: disposable wooden chopsticks
- ⟦{塗|ぬ}り{箸|ばし}→塗り箸：noentry⟧: lacquered chopsticks
- ⟦マイ→マイ：noentry⟧{箸|はし}: personal chopsticks (brought from home)

ETIQUETTE:
- Never stick {箸|はし} upright in rice (associated with funerals)
- Don't pass food chopstick-to-chopstick (also funeral-related)
- Don't point with {箸|はし}
- Rest {箸|はし} on the ⟦{箸置|はしお}き→箸置き：04481_hashioki⟧ (chopstick rest)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {箸|はし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use chopsticks
- {箸|はし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to eat with good appetite
- {箸|はし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かからない→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: completely useless (idiom)
